title: Detailed lemon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='lemonGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff59d'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#ffd600'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f2a900'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='endGrad' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe680'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e69800'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- main lemon body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='38' ry='27' fill='url(#lemonGrad)'/>

  <!-- shading crescent bottom -->
  <path d='M14 60 Q50 92 86 60 Q50 78 14 60 Z' fill='#e09400' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- top highlight sheen -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='40' rx='18' ry='9' fill='#fff59d' opacity='0.75'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='38' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- nub / stem end left -->
  <ellipse cx='12.5' cy='50' rx='5' ry='7' fill='url(#endGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='12.5' cy='47' rx='2.2' ry='2' fill='#f7b500'/>
  <circle cx='11.5' cy='44.5' r='1.2' fill='#b07a00'/>

  <!-- nub / stem end right -->
  <ellipse cx='87.5' cy='52' rx='5' ry='7' fill='url(#endGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='87.5' cy='49' rx='2.2' ry='2' fill='#f7b500'/>
  <circle cx='88.5' cy='46.5' r='1.2' fill='#b07a00'/>

  <!-- tiny dimple texture dots -->
  <g fill='#f2b200' opacity='0.55'>
    <circle cx='30' cy='50' r='1.1'/>
    <circle cx='38' cy='62' r='1.1'/>
    <circle cx='48' cy='45' r='1.1'/>
    <circle cx='58' cy='65' r='1.1'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='48' r='1.1'/>
    <circle cx='55' cy='38' r='1.1'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='58' r='1.1'/>
    <circle cx='26' cy='60' r='1.1'/>
    <circle cx='44' cy='68' r='1.1'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='38' r='1.1'/>
  </g>

  <!-- soft warm side glow -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='66' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#ffe14d' opacity='0.35'/>
</svg>
